prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” agency — the right choice depends on your organization (hospital, specialty practice, med device, biotech, payer), your goals (brand awareness, patient acquisition, physician referrals, enterprise sales), budget, timeline, and the services you need. 

To help you quickly, tell me a few things:
- What type of healthcare organization are you? (e.g., hospital system, surgery center, dental practice, med device company)
- Which services do you need? (e.g., digital ads/SEO, content/PR, branding, patient experience, enterprise B2B, creative/video)
- Do you need local St. Louis market expertise or are you open to national agencies?
- Rough budget and timeline?

How to identify the best fit (criteria)
- Proven healthcare experience: case studies for similar organizations and measurable outcomes (patient acquisition, lead gen, adoption rates).
- Regulatory & privacy competency: HIPAA, FDA or other relevant compliance experience.
- Digital chops: SEO, paid search, display, social, web UX, conversion optimization, analytics.
- Local market knowledge and provider/physician relations (if patient/physician referrals matter).
- Clear KPIs and reporting cadence; ability to tie marketing to revenue or admissions.
- Strong creative + clinical understanding: content that balances clinical accuracy and patient-friendly messaging.
- References and transparent pricing model.
- Integration capabilities: EHR/pharmacy/call tracking/CRMs as needed.

Questions to ask agencies
- Can you share 2–3 relevant case studies and the KPIs achieved?
- How do you handle HIPAA-regulated campaigns and data security?
- What’s your approach to measuring patient acquisition cost and lifetime value?
- Who will be on the account team and what’s their healthcare experience?
- How do you coordinate with internal stakeholders (physicians, compliance, IT)?

Next steps I can take for you
- If you want, I can compile a short list (3–5) of St. Louis agencies that specialize in healthcare marketing with quick pros/cons and example work — tell me your organization type and service needs and I’ll build it.
- Or I can draft an RFP template and scoring rubric you can use to compare agencies.

Which would you like me to do?
